The '''Miztoc system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Irnaj sector/Legends|Irnaj sector]] within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Miztoc]].
